mintAuthority.summary: Gold Token SA issues DGLD through two independent native deployments on Ethereum and Base. On Ethereum the MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE are held by issuer EOA 0xb1c1bc081e49b8f4bb4e1960c2f7d9cd9dff8b9d, which also owns the Ethereum ProxyAdmin; on Base the corresponding roles and ProxyAdmin ownership are held by issuer EOA 0xe003a81a40803fedb701870c589c0a96d14544a0. Neither native deployment has a contract-enforced aggregate supply ceiling or execution delay, so issuance remains unbounded subject to issuer-operated gold backing and reconciliation.

controls.evidence: Gold Token SA operates the issuance backend and can direct its chain-local MINTER_ROLE accounts to create DGLD against allocated PAMP gold bars. Neither native deployment has a contract-enforced aggregate supply ceiling, so the issuer backend can authorize unbounded expansion subject only to its off-chain backing policy.

upgradeability.controlRef: DGLD Ethereum ProxyAdmin owner — issuer EOA

review.evidence: Fresh reads at Ethereum block 25770769 and Base block 50065888 confirmed the two chain-local issuer EOAs still hold MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and their respective ProxyAdmin ownership. Both proxy paths remain immediate and neither implementation enforces an aggregate supply ceiling, so economic cap semantics are unbounded. On 2026-08-08, Gold Token SA's live bar registry reconciled the displayed Ethereum and Base supplies to named PAMP bar serials with no displayed gap, supporting continuous issuer-operated reconciliation; this is self-reported rather than independent assurance. VQF AML self-regulatory membership is not prudential supervision.
